fixes.eslint/no-console: log through the service's structured logger (Fastify's app.log or req.log, an object first, then the message), not console.
fixes.eslint/max-params: take one object of named fields instead of more than three positional parameters (the limit of 3 is ours).
fixes.typescript/consistent-type-assertions: don't cast: parse the value at its boundary with its schema, annotate the type (`const x: T = v`), or check it with `satisfies T`.
fixes.typescript/no-non-null-assertion: don't assert with `!`: check for the missing value and refuse or fall back (`if (x === undefined) throw …`, `?.`, `??`).
fixes.suppression: fix the finding instead of silencing it: a correctness rule is fixed, not silenced; a new suppression counts as a finding of its rule.
